name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the context and maintains the topic of conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the level of interaction in the response, such as asking follow-up questions or expressing interest in the other person's comments.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the conversation, ensuring that responses make sense in sequence.

name: Informative Content
description: Examines the presence of interesting facts or insights in the response that enhance the conversation.

name: Empathy
description: Measures the degree to which the response demonstrates understanding and consideration of the other person's feelings or perspectives.
